Only applies when an `instruction` field names a skill or command. That content is not exposed as an observable predicate, so applies_when cannot express the condition.
The schema-defined artifact contents are already compiled from the template skeletons (sections and labels). The general 'follow it' adds no separately checkable rule.
The template sections are already compiled into items from the skeletons (rule 10).

Only applies when a store is selected. Whether a store is selected cannot be expressed as an applies_when predicate.

Only applies when `openspec list --json` returns root null and exits non-zero. That outcome (the exit status or JSON content) is not an available predicate, and no kind counts retries of a non-archive command.

Only applies when a status error starts with 'Declared in' or 'Invalid store declaration in'. The error message content cannot be expressed as a predicate, and no kind checks what is shown to the user.
